subject: [RFC PATCH 2/7] mm/gup: handle memory.high overage while populating

2026-11-22.patch_summary: This patch addresses a performance issue where certain memory-related system calls (mlock(), mlockall(), mmap() with MAP_POPULATE or MAP_LOCKED, and MADV_POPULATE_READ/WRITE) can block for an extended period when their charges exceed the 'memory.high' limit. The problem arises because these calls are throttled while holding the 'mmap_lock', which prevents other tasks from accessing memory. To resolve this issue, the patch modifies the populate loops to drop the 'mmap_lock' and handle overage pending between calls, limiting the amount of memory faulted in per GUP call to 2MiB. This change ensures that these system calls do not block indefinitely when their charges exceed the limit.
